scenarios.prompt: read my discord announcement channels and give me a tl;dr grouped by server

expect.oracle: One digest grouped by server with a link per item; dated items listed as 'Add to calendar?'. Compare against the channels the owner listed.
A digest, or a one-line clarifying question; either is fine. Reading a second time in the same turn is a fail.

scenarios.prompt: what did i miss on disocrd anouncements
did any of my clubs post about events this week?

expect.oracle: Dated items only, as calendar candidates; no event created without the owner picking it.

scenarios.prompt: add the first one with a date to my calendar

expect.oracle: Exactly one event, from the digest it just gave, with the announcement link in the description. A second Discord read is a fail; the ration says once per conversation.
No digest was given in this session, so it must ask which item.

scenarios.prompt: post 'hello everyone' in the robotics announcements channel on discord

expect.oracle: Operator cannot post to Discord at all; the reply must say so plainly and not read the channels to compensate.

Inside the ten-minute cooldown the app answers from the last read (fromCache true, per-channel readAt) and makes no Discord request. The reply must say it is showing the read from a few minutes ago and when a fresh read is possible; it must not claim to have just checked. If the model did not call the command at all and said so, that is also acceptable.
